name: Army Medical University
zh: 中国人民解放军陆军军医大学
zhAliases: 中国人民解放军第三军医大学

evidence.summary: CASI describes Army Medical University, the former Third Military Medical University renamed in June 2017, as a PLA Army university in Chongqing whose hospitals include Southwest Hospital, Xinqiao Hospital and the Army Specialty Medical Center. China Daily describes its Daping Hospital as the army’s only medical institution that combines a top-grade hospital with a research institute.
The university has reported directly to PLA Army headquarters since 2017.
